sources.title: The Weekly Driver - GM Ultium small/mid battery (85 kWh, 10 modules)
sources.notes: Lists NCMA chemistry, 85 kWh (gross/usable not separated), 150 kW peak DC, and the Equinox EV (FWD, AWD) and Blazer EV LT/RS as users of the same 10-module pack.

sources.title: Jim Ellis Chevrolet - Why Drivers Are Loving the 2026 Chevy Blazer EV
sources.notes: US dealer page: LT and RS have an 85 kWh battery with up to 150 kW DC fast charging; SS has 102 kWh with up to 190 kW.

sources.title: Coughlin Chevrolet - 2026 Chevrolet Blazer EV AWD RS (VIN 3GNKD1RJ2TS104881) listing
sources.notes: US dealer window-sticker features for a 2026 RS AWD: 85 kWh battery rated energy, up to 150 kW DC fast-charging capable, 11.5 kW onboard charging module, 21-inch wheels (275/45R21).

sources.title: EVChargingStations - 2027 Chevrolet Blazer EV gets NACS
sources.notes: States the 2026 Blazer EV has a CCS1 port and the 2027 moves to native NACS; 85 kWh peak 150 kW, 102 kWh peak 190 kW; 2026 lineup LT/RS 85 kWh, SS 102 kWh.

battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver (spec site, no GM citation) says the 85 kWh Ultium pack is NCMA; nmc is the nearest value. Page lists the 85 kWh Ultium pack used in the Equinox EV (FWD and AWD) as NCMA (nickel cobalt manganese aluminum); recorded as nmc (the schema has no separate NCMA value). Spec-site relay of the GM pack description.

Estimated: The Weekly Driver (spec site, no GM citation) says the 85 kWh Ultium pack is NCMA; nmc is the nearest value. Page lists the 85 kWh Ultium pack used in the Equinox EV (FWD and AWD) as NCMA; recorded as nmc.

dc_max_kw.notes: US dealer page: LT and RS (85 kWh) up to 150 kW; 190 kW is the 102 kWh SS. Same wording on a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (src-coughlin-2026-blazer-ev-rs-awd) and in EVChargingStations (2027 article). Conflicts with the 190 kW already stored from thinkEV (which says 102 kWh for all trims; likely wrong for the 85 kWh pack).

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page gives usable kWh for the Blazer EV. The 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack is the same one in the Equinox EV (The Weekly Driver lists both), and the Equinox record (OpenEV) has 80 kWh usable.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: same 85 kWh 10-module Ultium pack as the Equinox EV (nominal 336 V per The Weekly Driver, 288 V per EVChargingStations; either way a 400 V-class pack, as stored for the Equinox).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the page is a 2026 RS AWD window sticker (11.5 kW onboard charging module). Other sources say every Blazer EV configuration has the 11.5 kW module; no 19.2 kW option found.

charge_port.notes: Article states the 2026 Blazer EV has a CCS1 port (2027 moves to native NACS). US article; Supercharger access is by adapter (already recorded).

dc_max_kw.notes: 2026 RS AWD window-sticker text: 85 kWh battery, up to 150 kW DC fast-charging capable. Conflicts with 190 kW (thinkEV) and 195 kW (OpenEV, which also lists 102 kWh gross / 97 usable for this variant, apparently the 102 kWh pack).
